title: PDFcn: shadcn-style PDF components for React, copy in, compose, preview live
description:
PDFcn gives React developers a shadcn-style component registry for generating PDFs without starting every document from raw layout primitives. You copy components into your codebase, customize themes and props, then compose tables, forms, charts, invoices, and reports with either Takumi or Forme. The documentation renders live previews, so changes are visible before export. It’s a component collection rather than a hosted editor, so document logic and renderer setup remain inside your application. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/shadcn-labs/pdfcn
